draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Bhagamandala! Up here the Kaveri is joined by the Kannike and the mythical Sujyothi, making this a sacred three-river meeting point. Pilgrims take a dip here before heading on to Talakaveri, where the Kaveri is born.
draft.hungryLine: This is a small pilgrim town, so keep meals simple and carry water for the temple and river.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Walk down to the triveni sangama where the rivers meet, then over to the Bhagandeshwara Temple a short distance away.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Sit by the confluence and watch pilgrims doing rituals for their ancestors at the water's edge.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Bhagamandala once had its own seat in the Coorg legislature, and it held just one election, in 1952.

spots.name: Bhagamandala
spots.detail: You're here · The triveni sangama where three rivers meet

spots.name: Bhagandeshwara Temple
spots.detail: Short walk from the sangama · Shiva temple at the heart of the pilgrimage

legends.title: From Shiva's hair
legends.body: Locals believe the Kaveri, which they revere as Dakshina Ganga, flows out of Shiva's matted locks right here. That's why the Bhagandeshwara Temple is so special.

tips.title: Expect crowds in mid-October.
tips.body: Pilgrims gather here in big numbers for Tula Sankramana on 17 or 18 October.

tips.title: Dress for the temple.
tips.body: This is an active pilgrimage spot, so cover up and be ready to remove footwear.

story.title: Sacred confluence
story.body: Bhagamandala sits on the upper Kaveri, about 898 m up, where two tributaries join it. River meetings like this, kudala in Kannada, are held sacred.

story.title: One election
story.body: Bhagamandala Nad had its own seat in the Coorg State legislature, and its only election was held in 1952. The local economy ran on exports of honey and cardamom.

story.title: Coorg joins Mysore
story.body: When states were redrawn along language lines, Coorg was merged into Mysore State. The Bhagamandala seat was abolished on paper that year.

story.title: Gateway to Talakaveri
story.body: Pilgrims still dip in the triveni sangama and do rituals for their ancestors here. Then they head on to Talakaveri, the Kaveri's birthplace.
